name: Zilliz Cloud
tagline: Fully managed Milvus from its creators, with serverless, dedicated and BYOC deployments.
description: Zilliz Cloud is the commercial managed service from Zilliz, the company behind most Milvus development. It exposes the Milvus API but runs Zilliz's proprietary Cardinal search engine and tiered storage, and offers Free, Serverless (pay per use), Dedicated and BYOC options across AWS, Google Cloud and Azure. Extras over open-source Milvus include automatic index tuning, data migration and import pipelines, backups, RBAC, audit logs and CMEK on Business Critical. Choose it if you want Milvus scale without running etcd, Pulsar/Woodpecker and object storage yourself.

pricing.notes: Free: 5 GB storage and 2.5M vCUs/month. Serverless bills per vCU and storage; Dedicated clusters billed per CU-hour; Business Critical and BYOC via sales.

scale.notes: Dedicated clusters scale query and storage capacity independently; tiered storage keeps cold vectors on object storage.

strengths: Milvus-compatible API, so you can move between self-hosted and managed
Cardinal engine and AutoIndex reduce manual index tuning
Serverless tier for spiky or small workloads
Available on all three hyperscalers plus BYOC
Enterprise controls: SSO, audit logs, CMEK, HIPAA eligibility
weaknesses: Proprietary engine means performance differs from open-source Milvus
Pricing units (vCU/CU) take effort to model
notIdealFor: Tiny hobby projects with strict cost caps
